title: Israel reportedly presses Lebanon to keep Hezbollah out of renewed Iran war
detail: A news report, relayed via Google News with the original outlet not identified, says Israel is pressing the Lebanese government to prevent Hezbollah from joining a renewed war with Iran. Single unverified report; no official confirmation or Lebanese response in the feed.

title: Israel asks Lebanese Army to deploy in Hezbollah-present areas
detail: Naharnet reports Israel is asking that the Lebanese Army deploy in areas where Hezbollah is present. Single report relayed via Google News; no official Israeli or Lebanese confirmation in the feed.
